create_SimplexBounds: create a SimplexBounds object specifying vertices, nominal inputs, and a dilation factor for interval bound propagation
build_SimplexBounds_apply_linear: build lower and upper interval bounds by applying a linear transformation to simplex vertices and nominal inputs
build_SimplexBounds_apply_conv1d: build interval bounds for a 1D convolution layer applied to simplex vertices with batch or per-batch vertex support
build_SimplexBounds_apply_conv2d: build interval bounds for a 2D convolution layer applied to simplex vertices with batch or per-batch vertex support
build_SimplexBounds_apply_increasing_mon: build interval bounds by applying an increasing monotonic function such as add, reduce_mean, reduce_sum, avg_pool, or quotient to simplex bounds
